messages:
Implement JSON Pointer (RFC 6901)

Add resolvePointer(document, pointer), which evaluates a JSON Pointer against
a JSON document one reference token at a time, and the JsonValue types the rest
of the toolkit will share.

Both failure modes of the specification throw a JsonPointerError, told apart by
its `code`: a malformed pointer ("invalid-pointer") and a well-formed pointer
with no value at that place ("unresolved"). Only own members are reachable, so
inherited properties such as "toString" do not resolve.

Node's TypeScript support runs the sources directly, so the tests need no build
step; in exchange the modules import each other with ".ts" extensions, which
tsc rewrites when it emits dist.
